vibe_rationale: Curated independent designer-maker market with a loyal following, but broad, shopping-led and commercial rather than scene-driven.
fit_notes: Pre-Christmas design-minded shoppers, with families, at the Royal Exhibition Building, and a claimed 50,000 a year. Weak wellness adjacency and little subculture depth. A stall or sampling route is the realistic entry, but partner tiers are not published and only two partners are named.
